name: ax-engineer-roadmap
description: Practical AX Engineer roadmap in Korean and English

scripts.bootstrap: npm ci --prefix site && npm run setup:e2e --prefix site
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-roadmap.mjs && node scripts/check-public-cases.mjs
scripts.check:cases: node scripts/check-cases.mjs && node scripts/generate-case-site-data.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-case-boundary-blocks.mjs --check
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:cases && npm run check:copy && npm run check:version && npm run check:readme --prefix site
scripts.test:site: npm run lint --prefix site && npm test --prefix site && npm run test:e2e --prefix site && npm run test:pages --prefix site
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run test:python && npm run audit && npm run test:site
scripts.verify: npm run bootstrap && npm run validate
